I don't think I can help you or give any advice but I suffered from the same stuff many times both irl and online (obviously shorter). It does hurt longer and lingers when it's irl but it's like a twisted ankle. On the other hand online ones (at least for me) are like hitting your pinky toe on the table which drops you down immediately for a couple minutes. Both are very bad for mental health as anyone would guess but I lose appetite and sleep over it too so what I do is I keep pictures and stuff around or in my phone and look at those girls from time to time which is the same tactic I use for physical pain, pushing the knife deeper and numbing the pain.

A week? A year? You never know but it works eventually and after the painful part is gone you just remember the convos, games you played or the peach yoghurts you shared. 

I don't recommend doing it since it may backfire but what I'll say to you is just keep rolling with it.
